# Bobagi

Bobagi is the personal portfolio of Gustavo Antonio Perin (also known as
Gustavo Aperin or just "Bobagi"), a Brazilian software developer. It showcases
web apps, games, automation tools and servers - most of them live on
subdomains of bobagi.space, with public source code on GitHub.

## Canonical URL
- https://bobagi.space/

## Languages
- English (en) and Brazilian Portuguese (pt) - toggle on the site.

## Live projects (own)
- Tic Tac Verse (Ultimate Tic Tac Toe game for Android - 9 boards in one, Chaos/Shift modes, 3 CPU levels, 6 languages): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bobagi.tictacverse - source: https://github.com/Bobagi/tictacverse
- Cartomania (strategic online collectible card game): https://cartomania.bobagi.space - source: https://github.com/Bobagi/cartomania
- Porkfolio (personal investing platform: Binance crypto automation + B3 stock portfolio): https://porkfolio.bobagi.space
- Warframe Farm Helper (where-to-farm search engine for Warframe: drops, relics, live Void fissures, Nightwave guides - 4 languages): https://warframe.bobagi.space - source: https://github.com/Bobagi/warframe-farm-helper
- RetroASM (in-browser IDE + simulator for a 16-bit retro Assembly CPU, includes a Bomberman written in Assembly): https://retroasm.bobagi.space - source: https://github.com/Bobagi/Bomberman
- Rhyme (real-time rhyme & freestyle trainer via Web Speech API, PT/EN/ES): https://rhyme.bobagi.space - source: https://github.com/Bobagi/rhyme
- Primordium (crafting game inspired by the book "How to Invent Everything"): https://primordium.bobagi.space - source: https://github.com/Bobagi/primordium
- Terraria Bobagi (modded tModLoader server with a live status page - players online, world state, mods): https://terraria.bobagi.space - source: https://github.com/Bobagi/terraria-status
- Blockaboom (block puzzle game for Android and web: clear lines, earn bricks, build an isometric village; 3 languages): https://block.bobagi.space
- Clonador (Android app cloner - run multiple instances of any app, no root, no ads; APK download): https://bobagi.space/clonador - source: https://github.com/Bobagi/clonador

## Client work
- Chéri Doces (artisan confectionery e-commerce, São Carlos/SP, Brazil): https://cheri.bobagi.space
- VS.Dragon (hand-printed anime t-shirt storefront, Porto, Portugal): https://vsdragon.bobagi.space

## Tools & bots
- Hero Wars Bot (browser automation that speaks the game's JSON-RPC API directly: own MD5 request signing, local battle simulation with the game's deterministic engine, and a safety layer that blocks any paid spend): https://herowars.bobagi.space
- Mouse Jiggler (anti-idle utility, downloadable): https://bobagi.space/MouseJiggler
- Snowflake Proxy (run a Tor Snowflake proxy in the browser): https://bobagi.space/SnowFlake
- IP Converter: https://next-ip-converter.vercel.app
- Terraria tModLoader Ubuntu server guide: https://github.com/Bobagi/Terraria-tModLoader-Ubuntu-Server
- Project Zomboid Ubuntu server guide: https://github.com/Bobagi/Project-Zomboid-Ubuntu-Server
